integrity: The new proof is self-contained; the embedded checker exhaustively verifies specified finite cases only; external novelty and independent scientific validation remain unperformed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to exact cyclic permutation dynamics, two distinct coordinate channels, independent equiprobable one-channel choices, and integer-multiple horizons; it is not a statement about rank-conditioned optimization or other dynamics.
title: Exact rank-deficiency law and Poisson threshold for random cyclic actuator schedules
